name: clickflash-ecosystem
description: ClickFlash Photography Ecosystem - 6 apps for professional photographers

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm run dev:master" "pnpm run dev:touch" "pnpm run dev:management" "pnpm run dev:gallery" "pnpm run dev:website" --names "master,touch,management,gallery,website" --prefix-colors "blue,green,purple,pink,cyan"
scripts.install:apps: pnpm --prefix apps/master install && pnpm --prefix apps/touch install && pnpm --prefix apps/management install && pnpm --prefix apps/gallery install && pnpm --prefix apps/website install && pnpm --prefix apps/moneytrash install
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:master && pnpm run build:touch && pnpm run build:management && pnpm run build:gallery && pnpm run build:website && pnpm run build:moneytrash
scripts.build:master: pnpm --prefix apps/master run build && pnpm --prefix apps/master run build:backend
scripts.build:touch: pnpm --prefix apps/touch run build && pnpm --prefix apps/touch run build:backend
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:master && pnpm run test:touch && pnpm run test:management && pnpm run test:gallery && pnpm run test:website && pnpm run test:moneytrash
scripts.test:ecosystem: pnpm --prefix apps/master test && pnpm --prefix apps/management test && pnpm --prefix apps/gallery test && pnpm --prefix apps/touch test
scripts.test:ecosystem:coverage: pnpm --prefix apps/master run test:coverage && pnpm --prefix apps/management run test:coverage && pnpm --prefix apps/gallery run test:coverage && pnpm --prefix apps/touch run test:coverage
scripts.test:ecosystem:ci: pnpm --prefix apps/master run test:ci && pnpm --prefix apps/management run test:ci && pnpm --prefix apps/gallery run test:ci && pnpm --prefix apps/touch run test:ci
scripts.test:e2e: npx tsx tests/ecosystem/reset.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.ecosystem.config.ts
scripts.lint:all: pnpm --prefix apps/master run lint && pnpm --prefix apps/touch run lint && pnpm --prefix apps/management run lint && pnpm --prefix apps/gallery run lint && pnpm --prefix apps/website run lint && pnpm --prefix apps/moneytrash run lint
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm --prefix apps/master run typecheck && pnpm --prefix apps/touch run typecheck && pnpm --prefix apps/management run typecheck && pnpm --prefix apps/gallery run typecheck && pnpm --prefix apps/website run typecheck && pnpm --prefix apps/moneytrash run typecheck
scripts.clean:all: pnpm --prefix apps/master run clean 2>/dev/null; pnpm --prefix apps/touch run clean 2>/dev/null; rm -rf apps/*/dist apps/*/.next apps/*/node_modules/.cache
